subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which session identity and size/model fields may be shown to end users, and which must remain redacted or log-only when context overflow recovery fails?
rationale: The request creates a user-visible diagnostic contract across channels; source paths can compute different estimates and may contain sensitive session or filesystem identifiers.

options.title: Approve a minimal redacted diagnostic
options.body: Show a safe display label, model reference, effective budget, and clearly labeled estimated size while keeping raw keys and file paths in logs.

options.title: Keep diagnostics log-only
options.body: Retain generic user recovery copy and improve structured logs/status surfaces instead of exposing more channel-visible detail.

options.title: Design a broader context-status surface
options.body: Treat overflow details as part of a reusable status and compaction-notification feature rather than an error-message-only change.

recommendation.title: Approve a minimal redacted diagnostic
recommendation.body: Show a safe display label, model reference, effective budget, and clearly labeled estimated size while keeping raw keys and file paths in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the runner, overflow recovery, and auto-reply output paths that would need to adopt the chosen contract.
